boundaries.name: recursive-proof-verification
boundaries.obligation: StepEnv.accepts stands for VerifierCircuitData::verify and for the in-circuit conditional proof gadgets; nothing is proved about plonky2 proof soundness, so an accepted previous-chain, update, deposit or channel-registration proof carries no meaning beyond the equalities this file checks.

boundaries.name: public-state-merkle-gadget
boundaries.obligation: StepEnv.merkleRoot stands for IncrementalMerkleProof::get_root and its in-circuit counterpart; no collision freedom or binding property of the Poseidon Merkle tree is assumed or proved, so 'the previous public state was inserted at index block_number' is not established by the model.

boundaries.name: update-inputs-commitment-injectivity
boundaries.obligation: The one-hot selection connects Poseidon commitments of the per-slot UpdateUserPublicInputs; that the selected wires equal the selected slot's public inputs holds only under an explicit collision premise on the compared pair (gates_selected_update_is_slot_update).

boundaries.name: verifier-key-limb-codec
boundaries.obligation: StepEnv.vdEncode / vdDecode stand for vd_to_vec and vd_from_pis_slice; their being a codec is the VdCodecSound premise, and no claim is made that the limbs identify a unique circuit.

boundaries.name: gate-lowering
boundaries.obligation: conditionally_verify_proof, add_proof_target_and_conditionally_verify(_cyclic), conditionally_connect_vd, select_vec, conditional_assert_eq, is_equal, assert_one and range_check are modeled by their intended local semantics; that the emitted plonky2 gates actually enforce those semantics is not proved.

boundaries.name: field-arithmetic-representation
boundaries.obligation: Wires are integer representatives. The in-circuit block-number increment is modeled as addition modulo the Goldilocks order and the 63-bit range check applies to the NEXT value only; nothing in this file range-checks the previous block number parsed out of the previous proof's public inputs.

boundaries.name: native-vs-circuit-refinement
boundaries.obligation: toPublicInputs (the Rust witness builder) and BlockStepGates (an arbitrary satisfying assignment) are separate models; no theorem claims that a gate-satisfying assignment must come from the native path, nor that the native path always produces a satisfying assignment.

boundaries.name: initial-state-and-cyclic-key-anchoring
boundaries.obligation: On a first step both initial_public_state and the emitted verifier key are free witnesses (resolve_prev_first_block_accepts_any_initial_state, gates_first_step_verifier_key_is_free); the anchoring must come from the block-hash-chain wrapper and from the contract's blockHashChainAt snapshot, neither of which is modeled here.

boundaries.name: sub-block-message-and-signature-authorization
boundaries.obligation: No signature, sig-cluster membership, N-of-N threshold or block-producer key is checked in this file. The admitted sub-block message, its folding into block_hash_chain, and the advance of bp_sig_chain are delegated to the update_channel_tree proof and to the aggregate-list proof consumed by the validity circuit; the model treats them as declared public inputs only.

boundaries.name: dummy-proof-substitution
boundaries.obligation: DummyProof construction and the substitution of dummy proofs into unselected branches are not modeled; the model only records the error raised when a dummy is missing.

boundaries.name: plonky2-builder-and-prover
boundaries.obligation: CircuitBuilder construction, builder.build and data.prove/data.verify are opaque; the registered public-input vector layout is modeled but its compilation is not.
